rate_offered.notes: Printed '1.25%' in the offered nominal rate; rate type 'קבועה', linkage 'לא צמוד'; adjusted '1.2540%', common '3.10%'; exit points 'לא קיימת' (stations: no); break 'אין אפשרות שבירה'; renewal 'לא קיים' / 'לא מתחדש'. Account type 304, product 101. Amount tiers merged into this record (each as printed): 100,000-499,999: nominal '1.25%', adjusted '1.2540%', common '3.10%'; 500,000-: nominal '1.25%', adjusted '1.2540%', common '3.30%'. Read 2026-11-09 from the data the page loads (https://apps.fibi.co.il/bff-depositmanagement/api/v1/bankmassad/depositDetails/46, 'effectiveDate' 2026-11-09, 'prime' 4.75); the 447 row is in the family 'פיקדונות מקובלים'.

source.title: פקודת מס הכנסה [נוסח חדש], נוסח רשות המסים, עמ' 204, סעיף 125ג(ג)(1): 15% על ריבית מנכס שאינו צמוד למדד; read through il-finance TXI-03 and TXI-04 (checked 2026-10-25)

tax_bucket.notes: Unlinked shekel deposit: interest taxed at 15% of the nominal interest (TXI-03); 'linked' means CPI or exchange rate, so an unlinked or prime-linked shekel deposit is in this bucket (TXI-04); the bank withholds 15% (TXI-08). Copied from the rule base (TXI-03's source, read 2026-10-25), not re-read today.
